description: This file defines the structure and styling of a web-based database visualizer interface, including HTML markup, CSS styles, and embedded JavaScript for dynamic behavior and data fetching.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting application state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders it in the main view.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data as a table within the UI.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, including handling of long text and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better readability.
